issues.title: Math insertion keyboard undo needs diagnosis
issues.evidence: Installed macOS math smoke verifies Cmd+Z removes the equation and Cmd+Shift+Z restores it, including when the Desk Save button had focus. Native text undo stays in the LaTeX editor.
issues.notes: Root cause: Electron native menu accelerator consumed Z before the renderer. before-input-event now passes Z/Y edit shortcuts to renderer editors; Canvas handles keys globally except during its Math dialog. Native Command-Q separately verified through CUA. Windows interaction and direct native Edit-menu actions remain separate unverified paths.
